subject.title: Control UI: Config upgrade/hardening suggestions should apply changes automatically with before/after diff and user acceptance, not direct users to edit files manually

question: Which Control UI config and security recommendations may mutate user config, and what confirmation, audit, restart, redaction, and dismissal policy must gate those mutations?
rationale: The requested implementation would let browser-originated UI guidance alter auth-related configuration, so automation should not choose the security boundary or product policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Allowlisted Recommendation Actions
options.body: Approve a narrow reusable UI pattern for vetted recommendations that routes through existing config validation and requires explicit before/after diff acceptance before applying.

options.title: Keep Recommendations Read-Only
options.body: Leave Control UI hardening guidance as text and docs only, avoiding UI-originated mutation for auth and security settings.

options.title: Defer Fixes To Doctor
options.body: Make doctor or upgrade-scan the canonical fixer and have the Control UI link users there instead of applying patches itself.

recommendation.title: Allowlisted Recommendation Actions
recommendation.body: Approve a narrow reusable UI pattern for vetted recommendations that routes through existing config validation and requires explicit before/after diff acceptance before applying.
